path.title: Two upper drawn/slot references; assumed cuff construction reference, exact stitch/fold function unverified.
Second upper reference; continuous photo-guided reading across printed/slit gaps.
Visible inner pencil/slot line along throat. Drawn line is observed; precise sewing allowance/function must be confirmed.
Visible inset perimeter pencil line; retained independently of physical cut outline.
Visible heel-side pencil/slot line; exact stitch/cutting semantics unverified.
Visible long lower pencil reference; sole attachment/lasting allowance is not validated.
Visible short diagonal pencil/slot reference at front return.
